definitions.full: H6092. atseb or atstsab [ עָצֵב , > עַצָּב ] noun [masculine] toiler (properly sufferer ; less well עֶצֶב toil Thes Kö ii. 1, 29 and others); — plural suffix תִּנְנּ֑שֹׁוּ עַצְּבֵיכֶם Isa 58:3 (dagesh forte dirimens Ges § 20h ) your toilers ye drive on ; Klo Che בְּיֶדְכֶם עֲבֹט (compare Vrss in part) money lent on pledge ye exact.
